# llms.txt — Zuhaib Ahmed Portfolio

## Project Overview
- **Name:** Zuhaib Ahmed Portfolio
- **Type:** Full-stack AI engineer portfolio website
- **Primary Focus:** Agentic AI systems, multi-agent LLM pipelines, and full-stack ML products

## LLM Integrations
- **Chatbot:** On-site AI assistant that answers questions about Zuhaib's skills, projects, and experience
- **Booking System:** End-to-end consulting booking with conflict detection and email notifications
- **Contact Form:** Inquiry submission with email delivery

## Design System
- **3 Preview Themes:** Original (dark glassmorphism), Minimal (light agency), Terminal (hacker), Editorial (magazine)
- **3D Scene:** React Three Fiber with 2,600 particles, floating geometric shapes, additive blending

## Key Capabilities
- **ResearchPilot:** Multi-agent autonomous research system (Planner, Researcher, Critic, Synthesizer)
- **AgroVision:** AI plant disease prediction — CNN on 54K+ images, 88% validation accuracy
- **Booking System:** Slot-based scheduling with real-time conflict detection
- **SEO:** Pre-rendered content, JSON-LD structured data, sitemap, GSC + Bing verified

## Tech Stack
- React 19 + Vite 6 + Tailwind CSS 3.4
- @react-three/fiber + @react-three/drei (3D)
- GSAP (animations)
- Supabase (backend database)
- Resend (transactional email)

## Development
- **Build:** `vite build && node scripts/prerender-seo.mjs`
- **Preview:** `npm run dev` with optional `?theme=minimal|terminal|editorial`
